2. A dry _______________ kept her awake all night.

3. I have a _______________ and I cannot swallow easily.

4. A _______________ is annoying but usually not serious.

5. If you have a _______________, stay at home.

6. He caught the _______________ in January and missed a week of school.

7. She sprained her ankle during the match.

8. There is a large _______________ on his knee after the fall.

Zdrowie — karty (Set A, cd.)

Mini-quiz A — napisz hasło po angielsku

Jak na egzaminie: definicja po angielsku → term.

1. signs that show you may be ill
 

2. to force air from your throat, often when you have a cold
 

3. pain in the throat, often with a cold
 

4. when liquid comes from your nose because of a cold
 

5. when your body is hotter than normal because you are ill
 

6. a serious illness with fever, aches and tiredness
 

7. to injure a joint by twisting it
 

8. a dark mark on the skin after a hit
